resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register describes the tower as Alabama Tower 62 in the past tense, while a blog says it received information that it is on the official state list. The story reports both, could not check the state list, and cites the September 2025 photo as the latest evidence that it stood.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: the only sources are the Register entry and one blog post. No build year, builder, design, staffing history or fire history was found. The brief's record had kind 'unknown' and agency blank, and the story says nothing on either. The September 2025 photo is credited to Will Sprinkle; its image URL and license were not checked, so no photo entry is included. A search for the official Alabama tower list (Alabama Tower 62) would be the next step. The drone videos linked on the Register and blog pages were not read.
